description_en: Connects a cloud service to WAF in cloud native mode. Supported cloud services include ECS, CLB, NLB, and Anti-DDoS
description_zh: 云产品接入WAF，支持ECS、CLB、NLB和DDoS产品接入
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-cloud-resource --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --listen '{"CustomCiphers":["ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384"],"ResourceRegionId":"cn-hangzhou","TLSVersion":"tlsv1","Http2Enabled":true,"CipherSuite":1,"EnableTLSv3":true,"Port":80,"ResourceProduct":"clb4","Certificates":[{}],"Protocol":"http","Domain":"www.c00sw.net","ResourceInstanceId":"lb-bp100000"}' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCloudResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of your WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The certificate type for the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:

default: default certificate.

extension: extension certificate
fields.help_zh:
HTTPS协议的证书类型。取值：

default：表示默认证书。

extension：表示拓展证书
fields.name: applied_type

fields.help_en:
The ID of the certificate to add.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718120.html to query the IDs of all SSL certificates associated with the cloud service instance
fields.help_zh:
要添加的证书的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718120.html查询云产品实例关联的所有SSL证书的ID
fields.name: certificate_id

fields.help_en: The list of certificate IDs
fields.help_zh: 证书ID列表
fields.name: certificates

fields.help_en:
The type of cipher suite to add. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:

1: all cipher suites.

2: strong cipher suites. This value is available only when TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.2.

99: custom cipher suites. This value is available only when TLSVersion is not set to tlsv1.3
fields.help_zh:
要添加的加密套件类型。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

1：表示添加全部加密套件。

2：表示添加强加密套件。仅TLSVersion取值为tlsv1.2时，可选择该取值。

99：表示添加自定义加密套件。仅 TLSVersion 取值不为tlsv1.3时，可选择该取值
fields.name: cipher_suite

fields.help_en: The specific custom cipher suites to add. This parameter is used only when CipherSuite is set to 99
fields.help_zh: 要添加的具体自定义加密套件。仅CipherSuite配置为99时，使用该参数
fields.name: custom_ciphers

fields.help_en:
The domain name to connect to WAF.
This parameter is required only when the cloud service type is ddos. For other service types, leave this field empty.
Refer to the Anti-DDoS connection documentation listed in the operation description for the applicable scope of domain names
fields.help_zh:
接入 WAF 的域名。
仅当云产品类型为ddos时，必填；其余产品类型，该字段为空。
域名的适用范围请参见接口说明中列出的 DDoS 接入文档
fields.name: domain

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether TLS 1.3 is supported. Valid values:

true: TLS 1.3 is supported.

false: TLS 1.3 is not supported.

This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. When TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.3, this value must be true
fields.help_zh:
是否支持TLS1.3版本。取值：

true：表示支持TLS1.3版本。

false：表示不支持TLS1.3版本。

仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。当TLSVersion为tlsv1.3时，此值必须为true
fields.name: enable_tlsv3

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:

true: HTTP/2 is enabled.

false (default): HTTP/2 is not enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启HTTP2。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

true：表示开启HTTP2。

false（默认）：表示不开启HTTP2
fields.name: http2_enabled

fields.help_en: The port of the cloud service connected to WAF
fields.help_zh: 接入WAF的云产品端口
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The protocol type
fields.help_zh: 协议类型
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en:
The ID of the cloud service instance.

The instance must meet the applicable scope of the corresponding cloud service (instance specifications, region, etc.). Refer to the corresponding product connection documentation listed in the operation description.

This parameter is required when ResourceProduct is set to ecs, clb4, clb7, or nlb
fields.help_zh:
云产品实例的ID。

该实例需满足对应云产品的接入适用范围（实例规格、所在地域等），详见接口说明中列出的对应产品接入文档。

当ResourceProduct取值为ecs、clb4、clb7或nlb时，此参数必填
fields.name: resource_instance_id

fields.help_en: The cloud service type
fields.help_zh: 云产品类型
fields.name: resource_product

fields.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud service.



This parameter is required when the instance ID to be connected has not been synchronized to WAF.
Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743902.html to synchronize ECS, CLB, and NLB assets, and call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743168.html to query the synchronized cloud service assets and their region IDs
fields.help_zh:
云产品归属地域ID。



要接入的实例ID未同步到WAF时，此参数必须输入。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743902.html接口同步ECS、CLB和NLB资产，并调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743168.html接口查询已同步的云产品资产及其归属地域ID
fields.name: resource_region_id

fields.help_en:
The TLS version to add. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:
tlsv1: TLS 1.0 and later. Highest compatibility, lower security.
tlsv1.1: TLS 1.1 and later. Good compatibility, good security.
tlsv1.2: TLS 1.2 and later. Good compatibility, highest security.
tlsv1.3: TLS 1.3 only. Highest security, lower compatibility
fields.help_zh:
要添加的TLS版本。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：
tlsv1(支持TLS1.0及以上版本，兼容性最高，安全性较低。)
tlsv1.1(支持TLS1.1及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性较好。)
tlsv1.2(支持TLS1.2及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性最高。)
tlsv1.3(仅支持 TLS 1.3版本，安全性最高，兼容性较低。)
fields.name: tls_version

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable persistent connections. Valid values:

true (default): Persistent connections are enabled.

false: Persistent connections are not enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否保持长连接。取值：

true（默认）：表示保持长连接。

false：表示不保持长连接
fields.name: keepalive

fields.help_en:
The number of requests that can reuse a persistent connection. Valid values: 60 to 1000.

After persistent connections are enabled, this parameter specifies how many requests can reuse a persistent connection
fields.help_zh:
复用长连接的请求个数。取值范围：60~1000，单位：个。

开启长连接后，复用多少个长连接
fields.name: keepalive_requests

fields.help_en:
The idle timeout period for persistent connections. Valid values: 10 to 3600. Default value: 3600. Unit: seconds.

Specifies how long an idle persistent connection remains open before it is released
fields.help_zh:
空闲长连接超时时间，取值范围：10~3600，默认3600，单位：秒。

复用的长连接空闲多久后释放
fields.name: keepalive_timeout

fields.help_en:
The maximum request body size. Valid values: 2 to 10. Default value: 2. Unit: GB.
Only the Ultimate Edition supports this parameter
fields.help_zh:
最大请求体大小。取值范围：2~10，默认值：2，单位：G。
仅旗舰版支持
fields.name: max_body_size

fields.help_en:
The read timeout period. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 3600
fields.help_zh:
读超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600
fields.name: read_timeout

fields.help_en: The custom request header field
fields.help_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value set for the custom request header field
fields.help_zh: 自定义请求头部字段设定的值
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The value of this parameter is in the format of [{"k":"key","v":"value"}], where key specifies the custom request header field and value specifies the value set for the field.

If the custom header field already exists in the request, the system overwrites the value of the custom field in the request with the specified traffic mark value
fields.help_zh:
该参数值的格式为[{"k":"key","v":"value"}]。其中，_key_表示所指定的自定义请求头部字段，_value_表示为该字段设定的值。

如果请求中已存在该自定义头部字段，系统将用所设定的流量标记值覆盖请求中该自定义字段的值
fields.name: request_headers

fields.help_en:
The write timeout period. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 3600
fields.help_zh:
写超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600
fields.name: write_timeout

fields.help_en:
The method that WAF uses to obtain the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:

0: No Layer 7 proxy is deployed in front of WAF.

1: WAF reads the first value in the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header as the client IP address.

2: WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify as the client IP address.

3: WAF reads the Client IP from the Proxy Protocol header as the client IP address
fields.help_zh:
WAF获取客户端真实IP的方式。取值：

0：表示客户端访问流量到WAF前没有经过其他七层代理转发。

1：表示WAF读取请求头中X-Forwarded-For（XFF）字段的第一个值作为客户端IP。

2：表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP。

3：表示WAF读取Proxy Protocol头中的Client IP作为客户端IP
fields.name: xff_header_mode

fields.help_en:
The list of custom header fields used to obtain the client IP address, in the format of ["header1","header2",……].

This parameter is required only when XffHeaderMode is set to 2, which indicates that WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify as the client IP address
fields.help_zh:
设置用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表，使用["header1","header2",……]格式表示。

仅在XffHeaderMode取值为2（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，需要设置该参数
fields.name: xff_headers

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use X-Forward-For-Proto to pass the protocol used by WAF. Valid values:

true (default): The protocol used by WAF is passed.

false: The protocol used by WAF is not passed
fields.help_zh:
X-Forward-For-Proto 传递WAF的协议。取值：

true（默认）：表示传递WAF的协议。

false：表示不传递WAF的协议
fields.name: xff_proto

fields.help_en: The tag key
fields.help_zh: 标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value
fields.help_zh: 标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the current resource ownership
parameters.name: owner_user_id

CloudResourceId.description_en: The ID of the connected resource, automatically generated by WAF
CloudResourceId.description_zh: 接入的资源ID，由WAF自动生成
